div.div:
Key Architecture Decisions
• App Service uses Managed Identity with Microsoft Entra ID for passwordless SQL authentication
• API connects directly to the Todo Database; the SQL Logical Server provides the logical hosting boundary
• Azure Application Insights receives application telemetry from the ASP.NET Core API
• No application/database password is stored for API → SQL authentication
• Key Vault is not currently required for the API's authentication model
• Azure DevOps uses Workload Identity Federation instead of a stored client secret
• Azure resources are managed through Bicep
